lines.text: That sword beats every other one!
That new sword is totally OP.

data.define: Short for overpowered; used when something is unfairly strong.

example.text: That new sword is totally OP.

misuse.text: Don't call a fair rule 'OP' in class.
misuse.why: It means unfairly strong in games.

hook.text: That sword beats every other one!

publish.title: What does "OP" mean?
publish.value: OP = Too powerful in a game. Example: "That new sword is totally OP." (casual English).
